class.name: LibSM64SurfaceCollisionData
class.brief_description: Read-only snapshot of a surface in the [code]libsm64[/code] world.
class.description: [LibSM64SurfaceCollisionData] describes a single surface (triangle) of the [code]libsm64[/code] world, as returned by the collision queries of [LibSM64]: [method LibSM64.surface_find_floor], [method LibSM64.surface_find_ceil] and [method LibSM64.surface_find_wall_collisions]. All positions, heights and offsets are converted to Godot's units and coordinate system using [member LibSM64.scale_factor]. [b]Note:[/b] Instances of this class are snapshots. They are not updated when the [code]libsm64[/code] world changes, and their properties are read-only.

members.member: The force the surface exerts over Mario. Only meaningful for surfaces that can move Mario, such as quicksand.
The internal flags of the surface.
The lower height of the surface.
The normal of the surface, in Godot's coordinate system.
The offset of the surface's plane along its normal.
The room the surface belongs to.
The terrain type of the surface.
The upper height of the surface.
Whether the surface is valid. Surfaces whose triangles are actually line segments are not valid, and are ignored by [code]libsm64[/code].
The three vertices of the surface's triangle, in Godot's coordinate system.
